claims.summary: Observed: scan_known_model_control_markers (L114) keeps a known marker in `remainder` only if reference_syntax is Some; contexts are Quoted/Grouped/ExplicitRelation (enum L42-46); followed_by_explicit_exact_token_relation (L64-86) preserves a marker that is the grammatical subject of an allowlisted verb (appears/behaves/represents/...).
claims.disposition: Verified from complete cited source at SHA 902a0358 (L42-46 enum, L49-60 reference_syntax, L64-86 relation allowlist, L114-144 scan/strip). Behavior already pinned by existing regressions preserves_grouped_and_explicit_relation_contexts and followed_by_explicit_exact_token_relation_allowlists_represents_not_creates (both pass). Prior report 1787135542.

claims.summary: Likely Snag: a punctuation-heavy string before the target verb might make first_word_after (L89-96) skip the relation or return empty, stripping the marker at L129-131.
claims.disposition: Contradiction preserved, not domesticated. first_word_after's .find(|w| !w.is_empty()) advances past punctuation-only chunks; existing regression grounds_first_word_after_punctuation_boundary proves `<end_of_turn> ... !!! represents ...` PRESERVES the marker and strips only when NO alphanumeric word follows (fail-closed). The hypothesized skip does not occur; underlying concern retained.

claims.summary: Likely Snag: a non-breaking space between marker and verb might make first_word_after skip the relation or return empty, stripping the marker.
claims.disposition: Contradiction preserved. split_whitespace (L91) treats U+00A0 as Unicode White_Space, so it separates it and the verb is still found. Existing regression grounds_first_word_after_non_breaking_space (grounding prior report 1786936281) proves `<end_of_turn>\u{a0}denotes ...` preserves the marker; U+FEFF/soft-hyphen/ZWJ/tab variants also covered. Hypothesized skip does not occur.

claims.summary: Test 1 (Context Preservation): a marker followed by "behaves" in a complex sentence is retained in the `remainder` of scan_known_model_control_markers.
claims.disposition: Already tested. preserves_grouped_and_explicit_relation_contexts asserts `<end_of_turn> behaves as a named boundary.` returns remainder unchanged with ExplicitExactKnownTokenRelation. Mid-sentence marker+relation covered by quoted_context_precedes_following_relation_verb (`The prompt <end_of_turn> is active`). Both pass at current SHA. Prior report 1787135542.

claims.summary: Test 2 (Delimiter Depth): exact_reference_delimiter_syntax identifies nested `[[MARKER]]` and respects MAX_EXACT_REFERENCE_DELIMITER_DEPTH (L151).
claims.disposition: Already tested. double_square_bracket_depth_two asserts `[[<end_of_turn>]]` -> Grouped, depth 2. MAX cap (=4, L151) grounded by bounds_homogeneous_square_bracket_stack_beyond_max_depth (`[[[[[...]]]]]` saturates at 4; grounds prior report 1787026288) and bounds_deeper_delimiter_receipt_without_dropping_token. All pass at current SHA.
